title: THAT YOU MAY KNOW THERE IS NO ONE LIKE ME

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Then the Lord said to Moses, "Get up early in the morning, confront Pharaoh and say to him, 'This is what the Lord, the God of the Hebrews, says: Let my people go, so that they may worship me, or this time I will send the full force of my plagues against you and against your officials and your people, so you may know that there is no one like me in all the earth.'" - Exodus 9:13-14 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Notice why God says He is acting: so you may know that there is no one like me in all the earth.

This is the answer to Pharaoh's very first question. He asked, who is the Lord? God has been answering ever since — river by river, plague by plague, dismantling every rival claim.

There is genuinely no one like Him. Not because He is the strongest among many powers, but because everything else that people call a god is nothing at all. The Nile is water. The sun is a created light. Pharaoh is a man with boils.

For a slave people, this was liberating news. The empire that seemed all-powerful was answerable to Someone.

And this remains our confidence. Whatever seems to hold the upper hand in your life — an illness, a debt, an addiction, a system that feels immovable — it is not without a Lord over it. Jesus said all authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Him (Mt 28:18).

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. What in my life have I been treating as more powerful than God?
2. Do I live as though there is truly no one like the Lord?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, there is no one like You. Cut every rival down to size in my thinking and let me fear You alone. Amen.
